Agent orchestration, single-agent harnesses, sessions, agent memory, tool gateways, credential custody and egress guards belong to the three-pillar runtime and substrate repositories (SylphxAI/anyagents, SylphxAI/spiron, SylphxAI/cloud, SylphxAI/sylphx). A product repository's existing part is listed here with an expiry date; after that date the entry stops applying and every pull request in that repository fails until the part is deleted. Delete an entry when its part is gone; extend a date only with a reason in the pull request.
